title: Llull’s complete answered questions with rule-species and correlative-role shorthand
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED. Ars brevis XI.11.2–11.3 explicitly resolves D by three question species, E by formal versus final cause, and -tivi/-biles/-are by active/receptive/act roles; the full angel/heaven argument preserves all answers, reasons and uncertainties.

source_evidence.quote: ## Actual complete content and contextual resolution

design.source_date_policy: The copied colophon explicitly says Pisa,monastery of SanDonnino,January1307. That source date is retained without resolving calendar-style conversion to modern dating. The work is unambiguously pre1450; no identical medieval hyphen shape is claimed.
design.source_ownership: Own the ALIM181 Latin transcription. Existing IDEA128 provenance attributes ALIM to Alois Madre1984,pp192–255; this task did not newly collate the print volume or a medieval manuscript. The comparison text at ramonllull.net makes explicit editorial changes, so it is not silently substituted.

all_written_reasons: A comparative God-likeness argument; preserve ALIM punctuation, which the comparison edition disputes.
If a bodily-and-intellectual composite exists, all the more an intellectual-and-intellectual composite exists.
Without angels the ladder of difference and concordance, and consequently the world, would be emptied, which the source rejects as impossible.
complete_content_inventory.limits: These are the source’s metaphysical arguments, not independently demonstrated empirical premises.

complete_content_inventory.question_content: From what, and whose, is an angel?
complete_content_inventory.written_answer: Under rule D: from itself; under its second species: from its spiritual correlatives; under its third: belonging to God.
all_written_reasons: The essence is not point-like or linear.
The written -tiuis / -bilibus / -are supply the correlatives of which it is composed.
Per -tiuos is active, per -bile receptive, -are is the act existing within/between -tiuos and -biles.
complete_content_inventory.limits: De se ipso is the source’s primitive/specification answer, not a claim of temporal self-creation or a physical stock. The actor/receptive/act scheme does not specify every lexical correlative root.

all_written_reasons: So that its principles have substantial and proper correlatives through its constellations.
complete_content_inventory.limits: Keep the constellation phrase; do not replace it by an invented mechanical actuator.

complete_content_inventory.question_content: Whether heaven moves itself to a place.
complete_content_inventory.written_answer: Affirmative in itself and in inferior things circularly, but not outside itself.
all_written_reasons: Outside itself it has, or can have, no action.
complete_content_inventory.limits: The coexistence of in inferioribus and non extra se is retained; it is not converted into an unambiguous modern trajectory or spatial containment theorem.

all_written_reasons: If it did, the -tiui of its correlatives would be below and -biles above.
It would then move elements and elemented things by its matter rather than by its form; this is called impossible.
complete_content_inventory.limits: The exact possessor in suorum and suam is not independently settled here. The source asserts the counterfactual reversal; the suffix rule alone does not prove that physical/metaphysical implication.

complete_content_inventory.question_content: Whether heaven has a motive soul.
all_written_reasons: Otherwise the sensitive and vegetative would have no motive souls, and elements no movement.
complete_content_inventory.limits: This is a dependency asserted by the source, not a current natural-scientific law.

complete_content_inventory.question_content: Under the first species of rule E: why does heaven exist?
complete_content_inventory.written_answer: Because it is constituted of its form and matter.
all_written_reasons: The first-species context selects the formal/constitutive answer category.
complete_content_inventory.limits: No numerical material portions or workshop mixture are implied.

complete_content_inventory.question_content: Under the second species of rule E: why does heaven exist?
complete_content_inventory.written_answer: So that inferior beings can have motion.
all_written_reasons: The second-species context selects the final/purpose answer category.
complete_content_inventory.limits: The closing Et haec de caelo sufficiant causa breuitatis remains owned; it is not an extra motion instruction.

D_rule_species.2: specific constituents, form/matter and spiritual correlatives

design.whole_hypothesis: A complete passage may be an answered question discourse using fixed typed references to shared rule species and correlative families. Subjects, positive/negative answers and reasons must remain explicit or follow one globally declared reference policy. Neither source alphabet order nor copied chamber order is assumed.
design.concrete_interaction: The same subject persists through constitutive, causal and motion questions; a species reference chooses what kind of answer a question requests. Active versus receptive correlative roles are reused in the reason for denying an external mover. The complete content is therefore constrained by more than the repeated letter names.

rivals.rule: D has one fixed substance/origin value.
rivals.different_consequence: It cannot preserve the explicit third-species ownership answer angelus est Dei as distinct from constituents.

rivals.rule: Both species of E denote the same cause.
rivals.different_consequence: It merges the source’s form/matter answer with its independently stated purpose, motion of inferior beings.
The active/receptive inversion in question75 no longer retains its asserted role distinction.

rivals.rule: The whole account is only an ordered chamber list.
rivals.different_consequence: It omits subject identity, eight explicit question/answer pairs, counterfactual reasons, explanation and closing prose.

residual_symmetries: Global relabeling of modern role names preserves the structure; source Latin binds their meanings here, but no Voynich sign has been bound.
A generic properly typed question/answer grammar could express the same content; historical notation by itself does not select a target writer.
The sparse shorthand does not supply every ordinary lexical value or the scope of all pronouns.
critical_limits: Leading hyphens are the owned modern transcription’s notation; no diplomatic medieval graphic claim.
The actual whole passage uses ordinary Latin prose plus letters, subtype references and correlative abbreviations. The five role classes are not an encoding of all its content.

Alphabet D also denotes duration, contrariety, heaven, fortitude and luxury; E also denotes power, principle, human, temperance and pride. Explicit rule context selects the interrogative family; the rule species selects within it. Neither D nor E alone chooses every interpretation.
ALIM’s full alphabet has the previously reported missing C sentence; it is not repaired from the comparison text. This packet uses the complete D/E sentences only.
The comparison edition’s rule headers use alphabetic labels where ALIM numbers3/4. Actual D/E references in questions72/77/78 are nevertheless printed in ALIM itself.
Comparison edition note17 disputes punctuation in question71’s first argument. Own ALIM punctuation; do not claim a uniquely parsed existence proof.

Question80 separately refers the why-specific-form question to the second species of E without giving its answer. Retain as a boundary warning against deciding every species from the noun form alone; no silent correction or universal classifier is inferred.
Primitive de se ipso and created-from-nothing in the prerequisite angel account are not flattened into one temporal-origin predicate.
The source’s theology and cosmology constrain its declared content, not an empirical truth test.
additional_interpretive_debts: Question75 suorum/suam ownership unresolved; do not manufacture an angel/heaven identity to close it.
Question74’s motion in inferioribus/non extra se is retained without a modern spatial repair.
No whole-text code, semantic solver or control corpus is built.
No new manuscript access, image, reserve or fixed group count.
design.structural_baseline: Directed composition, hierarchy at spaces, whole-form residuals and entry context remain measured background. No EVA alphabet or phonetic Latin assumption; these do not independently identify the source shorthand in a target.

predecessors.difference: Its complete ordered20-cell table and ten-letter fixed morphism differ from a complete question/answer block with explicitly selected rule species and correlative roles. Its rank/scope stops remain.

predecessors.retained: No rescue of the excluded fixed additive whole-line model by contextual extra codes.
Complete contextual note-duration example already exists; no duplicate music proposal.

design.smallest_future_decision: Before any target fitting, specify a complete admitted passage plus a finite writer for every question, subject, subtype, answer, argument and residual clause. The present source supplies genuine typed shorthand but neither that target owner nor its realization. Joint exploratory meanings are permitted without confirmed seedwords.
design.access: External source and bounded metadata/primary-method reads only; no manuscript packet/image/reserve or GDT991 runtime/results. No process management, refresh or commit.
